landing.eyebrow: Talent intelligence a egyina adanse so
landing.headline: Fa nokware si adwuma, mmɔ nhyehyɛe.
landing.subheadline: Caliber yɛ talent-intelligence platform: nkitaho a eda adi, AI screening a ɛyɛ adaptive, ne candidate agent a ɔyɛ nokwarefo — ɔden ne onipa a ɔwɔ mu.
landing.stat3: onipa pene so ansa na wɔpo
landing.systemTitle: Adanse baako fi role brief kɔ candidate agent.
landing.systemBody: Caliber ma hiring gyina adanse so: role specs bɛyɛ rubrics, rubrics bɛyɛ shortlist a emu da hɔ, interview bisa adanse koro no, na candidates kɔ anim wɔ verified claims nko ara so.
landing.feature1Body: Kyerɛ adwuma no Twi mu. Benya spec a etwa mu, rubric a ɛwɔ nkyerɛwee, ne nkitaho a wɔatete mu wɔ kwan so biara a emu nokware wɔ hɔ.
landing.feature2Body: Ɔno a ɔbisa abisade bɔ no mu no sua wo nimdeɛ biara na ɔma report card a ɛkyerɛ nokware — box tumm no nni hɔ, nnuhuma nso nni hɔ.
landing.feature3Body: Ɔyɛ adwuma bere a woada hɔ, fa kɔɔ bea a wo profile a wɔasesedee no si wo yiye — ɔmfa nnuhuma biara mma.
landing.closeTitle: Ayɛ krado ama demo room ne hiring ankasa.
landing.closeBody: Fi role, profile, anaa screening kwan so hyɛ ase. Caliber ma asɛm no nyinaa yɛ nea wobetumi ahwɛ bio.

auth.registerEyebrow: Bɔ workspace a wɔahyɛ da ahwɛ
auth.proofBody: Caliber de profile claims, interview scores, ne agent actions bata source evidence ho sɛ hiring teams ne candidates betumi anya ahotoso.
auth.proofBadge1Body: Claim biara kyerɛ baabi a efi
auth.proofBadge2Body: Decline hia review a ɛda adi
auth.signInPrompt: San kɔ evidence room no mu: shortlists, screenings, radar, ne candidate-agent adwuma wɔ baabi baako.
auth.passwordHint: Yi wo workspace role na fa password a ɛwɔ atwerɛ 12 anaa nea ɛboro saa.
